svg.aria-label: Architecture: public HMDA, PMMS and Census files are landed with manifests and converted to Parquet, built by dbt into DuckDB staging (rejects go to quarantine) and star-schema marts, checked by a quality gate, then served through a MetricFlow semantic layer to an MCP server with governed tools only.
svg.title: Architecture: public HMDA, PMMS and Census files are landed with manifests and converted to Parquet, built by dbt into DuckDB staging (rejects go to quarantine) and star-schema marts, checked by a quality gate, then served through a MetricFlow semantic layer to an MCP server with governed tools only.
